lines.text: Halt. Step one: name. Step two: purpose. Step three: do not touch the cables.
Welcome back. Step four: you are standing on cable two. Step off.

choice.text: What do you need from me, Warden?
The Span looks fine. Are the drills really necessary?

lines.text: ...A listener. Good. Come to the barrier at noon. I will explain the drill.
The Red Span looked fine. Thousands crossed. Hundreds did not.
